analyst.summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC crossed Rs 10 lakh crore in total assets under management this quarter and grew profit about 12% year-on-year, but a large part of the AUM milestone came from a large, lower-fee institutional (EPFO) mandate rather than higher-margin retail equity inflows - which is why the market's reaction to the headline was muted. The business remains a high-return, low-debt compounder benefiting from India's long-term shift of household savings into mutual funds, but the stock is not obviously cheap for its current pace of organic growth.
